criteria.requirement: Complete actual JSON1.1 adapter metadata: ordered authors arrays with name/url/avatar mapped to authors details, first author compatibility fields, feed/item language and detached item inheritance when absent. Explicit authors=[] suppresses author inheritance, and authors takes precedence over legacy author; retain existing single-author behavior. Validate array/member/string shapes and nonempty language explicitly so original parse bozo reports malformed data rather than silently dropping it. Preserve actual raw content/date handling, no new network or invented language inference.
Deliver the authorized source changes, public regression tests that fail on the original version, and English compatibility documentation. All frozen native regression tests must pass.

comparison: Accept equivalent implementations according to actual program behavior; do not grade by matching reference text or its length.
